meta.what: the fallback gate of task 8, and its verification on the 120 cells of W14
meta.signal: g = max_i |(x_i - x_mean_i)/x_std_i| over the network's thirteen inputs
meta.why_this_signal: W14: four inputs had zero training variance, clamp_min(1e-12) made their divisor 1e-12, and outside the training point the first layer saturates and the correction degenerates to one constant vector

threshold.rule: the largest standardised input attained anywhere in the committed training set; declared before the map was run and carried unchanged

step_size.note: h is one of the four inputs whose training variance was zero, so the corrector's step-size domain is 0.3 plus or minus three parts in 1e12

field_magnitude.note: B_z decays as exp(-t/tau), so the corrector leaves its own training range in |B| at a time that is inside the crossover horizon and outside the paper window

map.note: a cell whose gated fraction is 1.0 runs the plain Boris step at every step and its error is W14's Boris row exactly; a cell whose gated fraction is 0.0 runs the corrector at every step and its error is W14's corrector row exactly.  Nothing is re-measured against a reference here, because in the absence of a mixed cell there is nothing new to measure.

P3.prediction: the gate separates the 4 cells where the corrector wins from the other 116, with no false negative among the 4
